source: Book IV printed pp.76-77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.82-83
note: Wire list image-read from printed p.76 (PDF p.82) and matches programs.json wiresPrinted; no errata entry. Relay 6's coil (6E/6F) is unwired, so the carry-in is set by hand (relayGrab, contract 1.1). Step 3 is asserted while relay 6 is held left; the page never says to let go, so the script ends with the hand still on relay 6 (no relayRelease). Step 4 'Try other combinations' prints no outcomes and is not scripted. Step 2 states only light 6, so light 5 is not asserted there.

script.cite: Book IV printed p.77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83, Procedure step 1
script.quote: Turn power ON. Move slide switch 6 to the RIGHT; Input A is 0. Do not push pushbutton 6; input B is 0. Relay 6 is OFF; carry in is 0. Lights 5 and 6 are OFF.

script.cite: Book IV printed p.77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83, Procedure step 2
script.quote: Move slide switch 6 to the LEFT; input A is now 1. Light 6 comes ON: 1 + 0 + 0 = 1.

script.cite: Book IV printed p.77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83, Procedure step 3
script.quote: Manually move relay 6 to the left to indicate that carry in is 1. Light 6 goes OFF and light 5 comes ON: 1 + 0 + 1 = 0 and carry 1.
